comment: Pencil at 2 and 8 px, Wash at 6, 36 and 160 px and Oil Smudge at 8 and 9.15 px, the sizes painted on Windows, each at one and four motions a frame and at a pen's own 240 reports a second, under Sara's pointer at Never and at Both. Each window's state is d15-<preset>-<size>-<1|4|pen>-<pointer>, and every stroke leaves a 'Sara stroke:' line in run.log, which the record tables before and after the cut.
